verdict.rationale: The Secretary of State's own docs show it ships bulk data files to 'requestors of Bulk data' and offers a downloadable list of active Notaries Public, so first-party extracts that need no scraping do exist. The evidence is thin: there is no documentation of the bulk-data catalog, formats, update cadence, or how to get access, and 'requestor' implies a request process rather than open self-serve download. Missing for 10: documented business-entity bulk dataset contents and formats, self-serve access terms, refresh schedule, independent or hands-on corroboration of the downloads.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping

citations.quote: If you are a requestor of Bulk data, the new entity numbers will be reflected in the files.
